controls.title: Policies for AI (Objective)
controls.summary: Define overarching top-level mandates directing responsible, safe, and ethical development and deployment of AI across the entire organization.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: AI Policy
controls.summary: Augment the primary Information Security Policy with an enterprise Responsible AI Charter. Codify acceptable use of Generative AI, ban unauthorized public LLMs, and enforce intellectual property protection rules.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Policy & Roles Manifest / 政策規章與職責清冊]

controls.title: Alignment with Other Organizational Policies
controls.summary: Reconcile AI policies with Privacy Policies (GDPR/ISO 27701), Data Classification (ISO 27002 5.12), Data Protection (8.12), and IP/Copyright compliance. Eliminate policy conflicts regarding automated data ingest.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Policy & Roles Manifest / 政策規章與職責清冊]

controls.title: Review of the AI Policy
controls.summary: Establish periodic and event-triggered policy reviews driven by major regulatory changes (such as EU AI Act enforcement), critical security incidents, or adoption of disruptive foundation models.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Policy & Roles Manifest / 政策規章與職責清冊]

controls.title: Internal Organization (Objective)
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.2 Information security roles and responsibilities, 5.3 Segregation of duties
controls.summary: Establish organizational infrastructure and governance bodies responsible for assigning, executing, and validating AI accountability.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: AI Roles and Responsibilities
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.2 Roles and responsibilities, 5.3 Segregation of duties, 6.1 Screening
controls.summary: Delineate roles among AI System Owner, Lead Data Scientist, MLOps Engineer, Model Auditor, and Business Consumer. Enforce strict separation between algorithmic development access and production deployment rights.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Policy & Roles Manifest / 政策規章與職責清冊]

controls.title: Reporting Concerns
controls.summary: Expand existing incident response whistleblowing and helpdesk channels to enable all staff and external users to report model hallucinations, biased decisions, toxic outputs, or data leakage concerns.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Policy & Roles Manifest / 政策規章與職責清冊]

controls.title: Resources for AI Systems (Objective)
controls.iso27002_ref: 7.1 Physical security perimeters, 8.1 User endpoint devices
controls.summary: Establish organizational processes to define, procure, track, and manage data, tooling, compute infrastructure, and skilled personnel across all AI lifecycle stages.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: Documentation of Resources
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.9 Inventory of assets, 5.37 Documented operating procedures
controls.summary: Maintain a dedicated AI Asset Inventory tracking training datasets, feature repositories, model weight checkpoints, training scripts, hyperparameter configurations, and software dependency manifests (SBOM).
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Resource & Asset Inventory / 資產清冊與算力清單]

controls.title: Data Resources
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.10 Information deletion, 8.12 Data leakage prevention, 8.33 Test information
controls.summary: Verify training and validation data provenance, licensing scope, and labeling integrity. Enforce spectral anomaly filtering to prevent data poisoning. Mask PII in test and training splits. Compute SHA-256 digests for dataset integrity.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Resource & Asset Inventory / 資產清冊與算力清單]

controls.title: Tooling Resources
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.25 Secure development life cycle, 8.30 Outsoourced development
controls.summary: Control access and configuration baselines for MLOps toolchains (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, feature stores, data labeling platforms). Audit third-party labeling vendors for security posture and data transit security.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Resource & Asset Inventory / 資產清冊與算力清單]

controls.title: System and Computing Resources
controls.iso27002_ref: 7.1 Physical security perimeters, 8.1 User endpoint devices, 8.6 Capacity management
controls.summary: Telemetry monitoring for GPU/TPU clusters, high-bandwidth memory, and distributed training interconnects. Implement strict network isolation between training sandboxes and production inference enclaves.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Resource & Asset Inventory / 資產清冊與算力清單]

controls.title: Human Resources
controls.summary: Conduct technical and background screening for data labelers and ML engineers. Deliver semi-annual training on prompt injection mitigation, algorithmic bias identification, and data protection compliance.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Resource & Asset Inventory / 資產清冊與算力清單]

controls.title: Assessing Impacts of AI Systems (Objective)
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.7 Threat intelligence, 8.25 Secure development life cycle
controls.summary: Ensure the organization establishes and executes systematic assessment procedures to evaluate potential consequences of AI systems on individuals, groups, and society.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: AI System Impact Assessment Process
controls.summary: Define dynamic event-triggered assessment triggers: trigger re-assessments upon new model scope, ingestion of new data classes, algorithm architectural shifts, or expanded deployment contexts.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [AI Impact Assessment Sign-off / 衝擊評鑑報告]

controls.title: Documentation of AI System Impact Assessments
controls.summary: Produce formal AI System Impact Assessment (AIA) Reports documenting stakeholder registries, harm severity rankings, likelihood scores, residual risk treatments, and sign-offs.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [AI Impact Assessment Sign-off / 衝擊評鑑報告]

controls.title: Assessing Impact on Individuals or Groups
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.34 Privacy and protection of PII, *(Extended to ISO/IEC 27701)*
controls.summary: Quantify algorithmic bias and disparity across demographic groups using Disparate Impact Ratio (DIR) and Equalized Odds difference metrics. Evaluate impacts on consumer rights, physical safety, and personal autonomy.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [AI Impact Assessment Sign-off / 衝擊評鑑報告]

controls.title: Assessing Societal Impacts of AI Systems
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.5 Contact with authorities, 5.30 ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.summary: Analyze broad macroeconomic consequences, labor displacement, systemic public infrastructure dependencies, and carbon footprint from compute cycles. Enforce fallback protocols to prevent societal disruption.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [AI Impact Assessment Sign-off / 衝擊評鑑報告]

controls.title: Management Guidance for AI Systems (Objective)
controls.summary: Establish organizational governance policies and engineering guidelines ensuring responsible and trustworthy AI design throughout all lifecycle phases.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: Objectives for Responsible AI System Development
controls.summary: Formulate operational objectives for fairness, transparency, explainability, safety, privacy, and accountability during project inception; document anticipated benefits and misuse threat models.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: Processes for Responsible AI Design and Development
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.25 Secure development life cycle, 8.27 Secure system architecture
controls.summary: Embed trust criteria (fault tolerance, defensive distillation, model interpretability frameworks, human-in-the-loop overrides) into corporate software engineering baselines.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: AI System Development Lifecycle (Objective)
controls.summary: Ensure every development stage (specification, data engineering, model design, verification, deployment, operation, decommissioning) follows formal verification gates.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: AI System Requirements and Specification
controls.summary: Specify technical requirements for accuracy, inference latency, explainability (SHAP/LIME), bias tolerances (DIR 0.80 - 1.25), data drift thresholds (PSI < 0.10), and differential privacy budgets.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: AI System Design and Development Documentation
controls.summary: Maintain end-to-end provenance linking training scripts, dataset digests, hyperparameters, and resulting model weight checkpoints. Require Cosign digital signatures on container images and weights.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: AI System Verification and Validation (V&V)
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.29 Security testing, 8.31 Separation of development, test and production
controls.summary: Execute dual-track evaluation: Verification (conformance to algorithmic specifications) and Validation (fitness for intended purpose). Execute adversarial red-teaming, evasion testing, and out-of-distribution stress testing.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: AI System Deployment
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.25 Secure development life cycle, 8.32 Change management
controls.summary: Enforce canary releases, shadow mode deployments, and blue-green traffic splits with automated rollback switches triggered when live error or drift thresholds breach tolerances.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: AI System Operation and Monitoring
controls.summary: Implement continuous telemetry measuring data drift (Wasserstein Distance, PSI), concept drift, prediction confidence decay, and anomalous query payloads. Trigger automated alerts and retraining workflows.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: Technical Documentation of AI Systems
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.37 Documented operating procedures, 8.27 Secure system architecture
controls.summary: Author standardized Model Cards, Data Sheets, operating manuals, graceful degradation guidelines, manual override SOPs, and dependency bills of materials (SBOM).
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: AI System Event Logging
controls.summary: Record inference input tokens/features, predicted probabilities, operator override interventions, and runtime exceptions. Store logs in tamper-evident, append-only repositories while masking PII.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [MLOps Gate & V&V Report / 驗證與模型卡紀錄]

controls.title: Data for AI systems
controls.summary: Mandate end-to-end governance policies for all datasets applied across training, fine-tuning, validation, and testing pipelines.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Data Lineage & Masking Log / 資料血統與品質報告]

controls.title: Data for development and enhancement of AI systems
controls.summary: Implement automated data preprocessing, synthetic data generation, pseudonymization, and differential privacy ($\epsilon, \delta$ budgets) to protect training corpuses.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Data Lineage & Masking Log / 資料血統與品質報告]

controls.title: Acquisition of data
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.20 Addressing information security within supplier agreements, 5.36 Compliance with policies
controls.summary: Enforce copyright, intellectual property, and licensing validation for web-scraped and commercial datasets; audit consent and regulatory authorizations prior to ingestion.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Data Lineage & Masking Log / 資料血統與品質報告]

controls.title: Data quality for AI systems
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.16 Monitoring activities, 8.8 Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.summary: Continuous telemetry tracking statistical completeness, representativeness, label noise, and covariate shift; automated alerts for Population Stability Index (PSI).
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Data Lineage & Masking Log / 資料血統與品質報告]

controls.title: Provenance of data
controls.summary: Deploy Data Version Control (DVC) and AI Software Bill of Materials (AIBOM); bind every dataset commit to immutable SHA-256 cryptographic hashes and lineage graphs.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Data Lineage & Masking Log / 資料血統與品質報告]

controls.title: Data preparation
controls.summary: Secure access to centralized Feature Stores; strictly isolate training, validation, and test splits; execute automated tests to detect target leakage and temporal leakage.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Data Lineage & Masking Log / 資料血統與品質報告]

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.summary: Establish organizational protocols to communicate system capabilities, operational constraints, residual risks, and intended use to all internal and external stakeholders.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Model Card & User Notice / 模型卡與揭露標記]

controls.title: System documentation and specifications
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.37 Documented operating procedures, 8.25 Secure development life cycle
controls.summary: Publish standardized, version-controlled Model Cards and Data Cards detailing model architecture, performance baselines, known limitations, and bias evaluation benchmarks.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Model Card & User Notice / 模型卡與揭露標記]

controls.title: Understandability of information
controls.summary: Embed user-facing Explainable AI (XAI) outputs (e.g., local feature attribution, SHAP values, counterfactual explanations); deploy unambiguous synthetic media / AI disclosure badges.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Model Card & User Notice / 模型卡與揭露標記]

controls.title: External reporting
controls.iso27002_ref: 6.8 Information security event reporting, 5.36 Compliance with policies
controls.summary: Implement automated escalation runbooks to notify statutory authorities and affected subjects of critical algorithmic failures, privacy breaches, or systemic bias within 72 hours.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Model Card & User Notice / 模型卡與揭露標記]

controls.title: Communication of incidents
controls.summary: Deploy public status portals and user notifications communicating real-time model degradation, anomalous inference spikes, maintenance windows, and mitigation advisories. **MTTD/MTTR**: Public incident notification issued in < 60 minutes from severity-1 confirmation.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Model Card & User Notice / 模型卡與揭露標記]

controls.title: Use of AI systems
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.10 Acceptable use of information and other assets
controls.summary: Guarantee that deployed AI systems operate strictly within validated operational boundaries and risk thresholds, mitigating misuse and downstream harms.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Guardrail & HITL Sign-off / 護欄與人為覆寫審查]

controls.title: Processes for responsible use of AI systems
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.36 Compliance with policies, 6.3 Information security awareness
controls.summary: Implement role-based access control, dual-custody verification, and mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review protocols for all high-impact automated inferences.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Guardrail & HITL Sign-off / 護欄與人為覆寫審查]

controls.title: Objectives for responsible use of AI systems
controls.summary: Establish balanced scorecard metrics aligning corporate algorithmic revenue targets with safety constraints, fairness thresholds, and error tolerances.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Governance Charter / 治理方針與組織權責]

controls.title: Intended use of AI systems
controls.iso27002_ref: 8.1 User endpoint devices, 8.27 Secure architecture principles
controls.summary: Enforce multi-tier input/output guardrails, semantic classifiers, and prompt-filtering middleware to block prompt injection, jailbreaks, and out-of-scope system interactions.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Guardrail & HITL Sign-off / 護欄與人為覆寫審查]

controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Supplier SLA & Vendor Assessment / 供應商評鑑與條款]

controls.title: Allocation of responsibilities
controls.summary: Formalize shared responsibility matrices across contracts, identifying legal liabilities for Foundation Model Providers, Model Fine-Tuners, and System Deployers.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Supplier SLA & Vendor Assessment / 供應商評鑑與條款]

controls.title: Suppliers
controls.iso27002_ref: 5.21 Managing ICT supply chain, 5.22 Monitoring cloud services
controls.summary: Conduct AI-specific supplier assessments auditing training data provenance, vulnerability management, API SLAs, data retention, and fine-tuning privacy assurances.
controls.default_justification: Mandatory operational governance control aligned with organizational AIMS baseline.
controls.artifact: [Supplier SLA & Vendor Assessment / 供應商評鑑與條款]

controls.title: Customers
